title: Console + Runtime fusion weekly kickoff (orbit handoff)
content:
Context: quick, informal kickoff notes for the cross-team weekly. Goal is to keep the meeting <30m, surface regressions, confirm rollouts, and leave with 3 clear action items. Use this doc as the source of truth for follow-ups and to seed the standup snippets.

Attendees (invited): Hannah (host), Miguel (runtime infra), Priya (console), Tara (observability), Ken (SRE), optional: Sasha (solutions eng)

Timebox: 25 minutes total
  - 0-3m: quick metrics + announcements
  - 3-12m: rollout / canary health checks + flags
  - 12-18m: incidents / regressions / open blockers (15m max)
  - 18-23m: action item assignment + quick dependencies
  - 23-25m: parking lot + next check-in cadence

Quick metrics snapshot (last 24h) — bring numbers if you have ’em:
  - p95 latency hosted gen: 220ms (target 200ms) — small uptick since 03/10
  - p99 latency serving-runtime: 1.07s (was 980ms)
  - KV cache hit rate (default shards): 68% (target >75%)
  - Avg tokens/sec per GPU pool: 62 tps (dedicated-prod pool B)
  - Error budget burn for Dedicated pool B: 0.9% (ok)
  - Cost per 1k tokens (approx): $0.32 hosted / $0.19 dedicated

Announcements / FYIs:
  - Canary for quantized-7b-v2-compact rolling in EU region tonight (Miguel) — watch for model mismatch logs (CON-88).
  - Console deploy will include new batch-size slider UX; might increase simultaneous concurrent requests to a route (Priya).
  - Retrospective follow-up on last week’s autoscaler churn: SRE are testing new cooldowns (Ken).

Rollout health checks (ask: green/yellow/red & quick evidence):
  - quantized-7b-v2-compact canary (EU-1): Miguel -> yellow. Observed higher p99 for sequences >1024. Logs: INF-3245 traces show extra kernel fallback. Action: collect 10 failing traces and upload to GH gist.
  - console route /v1/generate batch slider: Priya -> green in staging; need prod traffic profile test. Add small shadow traffic run tomorrow.

Incidents / regressions / blockers:
  - Regression: p99 bump correlated with kernel fallback when sequence length spikes. Hypothesis: malformed shape detection causing fallback to slower kernel. Open Jira INF-3245 (assigned Miguel).
  - Blocker: A/B routing fails intermittently when Console sends mixed model-version header (observed twice). Investigation ticket CON-88 (Priya).
  - Observability gap: token-level cost attribution for cache hits vs misses is coarse in current dashboard (Tara). Need a short-term query for weekly on-call.

Action items (clear owner + due date + acceptance):
  1) Miguel: gather and upload 10 representative kernel-fallback traces for sequences >1024 to GH gist; include raw logs and minimal repro prompts. Due: 2026-03-14. Acceptance: gist link in Jira INF-3245 and brief note in this doc.
  2) Priya: schedule a 1h shadow-traffic run for /v1/generate with new batch slider config in prod-candidate; provide result brief (latency/throughput) to this thread. Due: 2026-03-13. Acceptance: CI compare table + any anomalies called out.
  3) Tara + Ken: short-term dashboard query to break down token cost by cache-hit vs cache-miss (SQL or PromQL snippet), plus a 24h report scheduled for next sync. Due: 2026-03-15. Acceptance: link to dashboard tile and sample export.
  4) Hannah: consolidate follow-ups and ping sales/SE if the canary degradation is customer-impacting; prep customer-facing note template if needed. Due: 2026-03-13. Acceptance: note template in linked artifacts or emailed to SEs.

Parking lot / non-blocking items (capture, assign later):
  - Consider making KV cache shard count dynamic per pool based on traffic shape (low priority spike mitigation).
  - Longer-term: automatic kernel selection telemetry to feed model-onboarding checklist.
  - Postmortem draft for autoscaler churn (Ken lead) — low priority for this cycle.

Questions to bring up in sync:
  - Is the kernel fallback deterministic for a given model + seq_len, or noisy? (Miguel to confirm.)
  - Will console batch UI allow specifying a per-route max batch size? If yes, product decision needed on defaults.
  - Any concerns with shadow traffic causing quota/accounting side effects? (ask Billing/GTM)

Meeting artifacts to attach after meeting:
  - Meeting minutes (short bullets) + final action item statuses
  - Links: INF-3245, CON-88, GH PR #412, dashboard screenshots

Prep checklist for me (Hannah):
  - Pull last 24h p99/p95 numbers from prod metrics (done — see snapshot)
  - Drop a Slack invite to attendees + add link to this doc (TODO)
  - Print quick one-liner for each action item to ping assignees during meeting (TODO)

Notes-to-self / freeform scratch: 
  - If Miguel’s traces show repeated kernel fallback, ask if we can force the faster kernel for canary to isolate effects.
  - If batch slider in console ups concurrency, consider a soft cap in the router for first 48h after deploy.
  - Keep these weekly; if metrics stabilize for 2 consecutive weeks consider biweekly check-ins.

Next meeting: propose 2026-03-18 09:30 PT (tentative)

-- end --
